# Switchery (vendored)

- Version: 0.8.2 (last upstream release, about 2015; unmaintained)
- Source: https://github.com/abpetkov/switchery
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Usage: on/off toggles on the settings screen (`cooked-switchery` handles, admin).

Candidate for replacement by a CSS-only toggle in the admin UI redesign. Bump the
version in `src/Admin/Enqueues.php` (`cooked-switchery` handles) if the files change.
